$comment: Lifecycle policy for the isolated plugin-artifacts bucket (AGL-944). Apply with: gcloud storage buckets update gs://$PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_BUCKET --lifecycle-file=cloud/plugin-artifacts-lifecycle.json  — read it back with: gcloud storage buckets describe gs://$PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_BUCKET --format='value(lifecycle_config)'. Revert with --clear-lifecycle.
$why: AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload is the ONLY rule that is safe on this bucket. It reaps abandoned partial uploads and can never touch a finished object, so a published bundle is out of its reach by construction. There is deliberately NO age-based Delete rule: lifecycle matches on age/class/prefix and has no view of Firestore, while installs pin bundles by exact sha256 and the bucket has no object versioning — an aged-out bundle would 404 the loader and disable that plugin for every workspace pinned to it, unrecoverably. Reclaiming real orphans is a Firestore join instead: POST /api/admin/reap-plugin-artifacts (AGL-942), weekly. See docs/PLUGIN_LOADING.md.
